line: Clawd hops out of the terminal into the Claude app and acts out plan mode and self-checks in one take.
line_cn: 像素小人 Clawd 搬进 Claude 应用，一镜到底演示 Plan 模式和自检。

motion.cuts: one-take UI flythrough or snap zoom

camera.move: Push-in to the cursor or caret
camera.serves: typing a prompt; choosing a menu item; a setting

camera.expresses: the app is alive while we listen
camera.serves: a line of narration; waiting for a result
sending a message → a result appearing; code → preview
a safety guarantee; a price; an undo

transitions: A recording-software camera: one continuous take inside the screen, zoom ≥ 1, cuts only under chapter transitions.
Transitions: chapter pill wipes, pixel wipes, a theme reveal circle;
labels: UI type follows the product (or licence-free look-alikes such as Inter, JetBrains Mono, a serif for editorial UIs).
Information layers only: a chapter pill (01–04), a KeyCastr-style keystroke HUD, frosted-glass caption pills, an optional "▶▶ 4×" time-lapse tag. Nothing else overlays the screen.
Captions sit in a pill at the bottom, never over the element being discussed and never under the mascot; hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
A title, if any, is diegetic: it appears as part of the UI (an empty-state heading, a window title, a notification).
motion: 30 fps; UI on ones; mascot position stepped to its pixel grid.

Mascot acting: jumps with anticipation crouch, stretch on take-off, tucked legs, landing squash with a damped bounce and dust. Idle breathes (a tiny squash) on the score's beat and blinks irregularly. Walks by leg alternation, flipping the sprite for direction.
Eyes carry the acting (neutral / left / right / up / down / wide / happy / shut / blink): they look at what matters. Arms: down / up (cheer) / wave.
Cursor: smoothed, spring-eased paths, small push on click, never teleports.

native_moves.name: Match-cut origin
native_moves.does: The mascot is born from something already in the UI (a logo's block characters, an icon, a loading spinner) and climbs out, leaving an outline.
native_moves.fits: a chat bubble turning into a guide; an icon becoming an assistant; a spinner becoming a helper.

native_moves.name: Diegetic title
native_moves.does: The name appears as a real UI element; the mascot lands on it on a downbeat.
native_moves.fits: an empty state; a new-project dialog; a welcome email.

native_moves.name: Moving floor
native_moves.does: The mascot rides a caret, a popup, a sent message, a progress bar.
native_moves.fits: a message flying into a thread; an upload bar; a drag-and-drop.

native_moves.name: Time-lapse with a tag
native_moves.does: Long work runs at N× with a flashing tag and rack focus.
native_moves.fits: indexing a library; a data import; a build.

native_moves.name: Spotlight freeze
native_moves.does: Push in and vignette the one badge that holds the promise.

native_moves.name: The film changes state
native_moves.does: A toggle's effect escapes the preview and takes over the whole film, and returns later.
native_moves.fits: dark mode; a language switch; offline mode.

native_moves.name: Cell division
native_moves.does: A new session or window splits the screen and the mascot splits with a pixel burst.
native_moves.fits: parallel tasks; multiple accounts; team members.

native_moves.name: Cursor and mascot as characters
native_moves.does: The cursor pets, pokes or drags the mascot, and it reacts.
native_moves.fits: approving a suggestion; undoing; onboarding delight.

native_moves.name: Karaoke-ball words
native_moves.does: The mascot hops from word to word as they are spoken.
native_moves.fits: a slogan; a shortcut list; step names.

score.note: two resolutions: a hi-fi band is the world, a chiptune square is the mascot; they trade and merge
